gen-dafont-stentiga-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall on a soaring x-height, with a wide e and strokes cut to one width, all friendly and unfussy. Stentiga's spread-out, luxurious letters sit above it like a quiet flourish.
gen-gf-tektur-archivo: Expressive from the first glance, Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with outsized lowercase and open curve endings. And Archivo, with its commanding x-height and outward-opening curves, brings an editorial steadiness that holds it all together.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-asap: Asap keeps its body height nearly level with the capitals and its curves open, giving text a readable, businesslike footing. Tektur does the showing off; Asap does the steady talking.
gen-dafont-woodgod-switzer: Commanding and a little vintage, Woodgod lets its tall lowercase nearly touch the capitals through wide channels into each bowl. Switzer, by contrast, offers wire-like, Swiss-minded letters with open tips and a high waist line.
gen-flavors-fs-supreme: Flavors has a towering, pencil-stub x-height with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Supreme follows in crisp, sturdy sans that holds its curves open, so a long page feels dense but never cramped.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads sturdy and trustworthy, with a hefty lowercase and broad openings on c and s. Autour One adds bold, round display letters whose strokes all carry the same visual weight, so the two feel solidly built.
gen-gf-funnel-display-general-sans: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width, with little step between capitals and lowercase. General Sans holds a steady pressure across a full line, its tall x-height and smooth bends carrying a long stretch of text without snagging.
gen-gf-goldman-manrope: Manrope has a bright gap at every curve and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, all in one line width. Goldman does the commanding, widely set announcing; Manrope does the approachable, clean explaining.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and unclamped, with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips on a wire-like skeleton. Epilogue works nicely a few points smaller than Gugi, whose bold, tall-lowercase letters can carry more size.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-public-s: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, its broad c and s openings keeping text easy going. Love Ya Like A Sister adds bold ribbon-like strokes of constant width, with outward-pointing terminals giving the top line its expressive lilt.
